critical_code_review_comments: pack.py:52 _mark_paid uses a conditional update ({status:{$ne:'paid'}}) so the receipt is sent exactly once even if the polling fallback and a future webhook race — good idempotency.

pack.py:82 send_receipt sets receipt_sent_at and receipt_email_id on success and receipt_error on failure, and pack.sync_pending retries on subsequent status GETs when customer_email is set but receipt_sent_at is null — resilient to transient Resend hiccups.

emailer.py:76 _assert_safe_email enforces no forms/input tags, no credential-asking phrases, https-only links, and same-site anchor host — strong outbound safety guardrails against phishing content, called before every send.
server.py:519 stripe_webhook wraps pack.handle_webhook and returns 400 on any exception; combined with pack.py:133 (no signature ⇒ 'Webhook non configuré'), unsigned pings can never mutate state.

report.py:141-158 adds the 'Photos du bien' page after PageBreak using retouched images when available, each captioned 'Visuel retouché par IA · non contractuel' or 'Photo d'origine' — matches the review request semantics.

pack.tsx:92 renders pack-receipt only when last_order.status=='paid' AND customer_email is present, showing 'Reçu envoyé à …' when receipt_sent is true and 'Reçu en cours d'envoi à …' otherwise — good UX for the async send window.
